projects.title: Kaleidoscope
projects.subtitle: Different lives. A new composition.
projects.alt: Models wearing contrasting patchwork denim jackets from the supplied ROHENI portfolio
projects.intro: Denim remembers. Its faded blues, worn seams and softened surfaces carry traces of the people who wore it before. Kaleidoscope brings those differences into a new composition.

sections.title: A material with a past
sections.text: We work with discarded denim and factory offcuts, looking closely at their colour, texture and remaining potential. Each piece of material changes the possibilities of the garment.

sections.title: Working through contrast
sections.text: Patch placement, proportion and silhouette give the fragments a relationship. The original material stays visible, becoming part of what makes the finished jacket individual.

sections.title: What comes next
sections.text: The next collection explores curved panels, irregular pockets and more precise fit. Sampling helps us understand where an expressive design also needs a clearer construction brief.

projects.title: The Herd
projects.subtitle: A shared identity. An individual presence.
projects.alt: ROHENI cowhide and leather jackets shown on models
projects.intro: The Herd begins with the physical presence of cowhide and leather. Markings, texture and variation guide how a piece takes shape. Each jacket belongs to the same world, while carrying its own character.

sections.title: Following the material
sections.text: Working with irregular markings means making decisions about where a surface belongs and how it changes the balance of a garment. The material becomes part of the design process.

sections.title: Clothing with presence
sections.text: These are pieces for people who want to express themselves through what they wear. Construction and proportion give their strong textures a wearable form.

sections.title: Sourcing with care
sections.text: ROHENI sources factory cutoffs and waste materials. The source of each featured hide and leather panel should be recorded individually as our material documentation develops.

projects.title: Adwoa
projects.subtitle: A set with a presence of its own.
projects.alt: A model wearing the Adwoa top and skirt set from ROHENI’s first collection
projects.intro: Adwoa brings another expression to the first collection through a coordinated top and skirt. Cutouts, contrasting surfaces and the relationship between the pieces shape the look.

sections.title: Two pieces, one conversation
sections.text: A set lets us explore how a top and skirt work together through shape, proportion and styling. Each piece also gives the wearer room to make the look their own.

sections.title: A wider expression
sections.text: The women’s sets broaden the ROHENI world beyond its signature jackets, keeping individuality and African creativity at the centre.

gallery.caption: Adwoa, shown as a coordinated look from the first collection.
A second view of the top and skirt, with their proportions visible.

projects.title: Smaller stories
projects.subtitle: Material character, made to carry.
projects.alt: A cowhide bag from ROHENI’s supplied accessory images
projects.intro: Bags and accessories extend the collection’s material language into everyday objects. Their scale opens further possibilities for working with smaller pieces and remnants.

sections.title: Looking at what remains
sections.text: A smaller piece can invite another idea. We explore how remnants and contrasting surfaces can become useful objects with the same character as the clothing.

sections.title: A tangible connection
sections.text: For local customers and visitors discovering Kenyan creativity, an accessory offers a way to carry the work into everyday life. Material sources and maker credits will be documented individually.
